title: LOGICSCORE: Fine-grained Logic Evaluation of Conciseness, Completeness, and Determinateness in Attributed Question Answering
reasoning: The paper focuses on the logical evaluation of LLM outputs in Attributed Question Answering. It addresses technical dimensions like completeness and conciseness using formal logic (Horn Rules). It does not evaluate religious content, theology, or ethical belief systems, though it does contain a standard ethical statement regarding data usage.
